desc: Implement trie construction: insert each word, record for each index i the list of node ids along its path, and store each node's count and depth.
Build valid[d] = number of nodes at depth d with count >= k, plus a lazy max-heap of candidate depths for O(log) max-depth queries.
For each index i: decrement counts along its path (updating valid[]/heap on k-threshold transitions), record answer[i] as deepest valid depth (0 if none), then restore counts by re-walking the path.
Handle edge cases: n - 1 < k short-circuits to all zeros; k == 1 works naturally; root (depth 0) never counted; duplicates handled via counts.
Verify solution against both given examples and stress-test vs brute force on random small inputs (k=1, k=n, n-1<k, identical/distinct words, single word); fix any discrepancies.
